붐비는 도로의 상태를 1분마다 기록하기Log the busiest roads every minute

5분 동안 차량이 채워지기를 기다린 뒤 가장 붐비는 링크 세 개를 골라, 시나리오가 끝날 때까지 1분마다 차량 수와 평균 속도를 CSV 파일에 기록합니다.After five minutes of fill-up, pick the three busiest links and write their vehicle count and mean speed to a CSV every minute until the scenario ends.

launch_and_connectsim_stepget_link_id_listget_link_vehicle_countget_link_mean_speed_mpsget_sim_time_millisis_finished
시작하기 전에 NextCI 시작하기의 준비 세 단계를 마치고, SimulationInput/config.txt에 network=bucheon이 지정되어 있는지 확인하세요(네트워크 폴더: SimulationInput/networks/bucheon/).Before you start: finish the three setup steps in NextCI getting started, and make sure SimulationInput/config.txt says network=bucheon (network folder SimulationInput/networks/bucheon/).

NextCI/examples/tutorials/t1_log_links.py

전체 예제 코드Full example code
"""Tutorial 1: log the state of the busiest links to a CSV file every minute."""
import csv

from nextci import NextCIClient, NextCIStatusError


def busiest_links(client, n):
    """The n links with the most vehicles right now."""
    counts = {}
    for link in client.get_link_id_list():
        try:
            counts[link] = client.get_link_vehicle_count(link)
        except NextCIStatusError:        # intersection-internal links cannot be queried one by one
            pass
    return sorted(counts, key=counts.get, reverse=True)[:n]


with NextCIClient().launch_and_connect() as client, open("links.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
    client.sim_step(3000)                # the first 5 min fill the network
    links = busiest_links(client, 3)

    out = csv.writer(f)
    out.writerow(["time_s", "link_id", "vehicles", "mean_speed_mps"])
    while not client.is_finished():
        client.sim_step(600)             # 60 s
        t = client.get_sim_time_millis() / 1000
        for link in links:
            out.writerow([t, link,
                          client.get_link_vehicle_count(link),
                          round(client.get_link_mean_speed_mps(link), 2)])

실행Run

python3 NextCI/examples/tutorials/t1_log_links.py

살펴볼 점What to notice

  • get_link_id_list()에는 교차로 내부 링크도 들어 있으므로, 링크별 조회를 try로 감싸서 NextCIStatusError가 발생한 링크는 건너뜁니다.get_link_id_list() includes intersection-internal links, so per-link queries sit in a try that skips NextCIStatusError.
  • sim_step(600)은 60초에 해당합니다. 1사이클이 0.1초이기 때문입니다.sim_step(600) is 60 s, because one cycle is 0.1 s.
  • is_finished()가 True가 되면 반복이 끝납니다. 10분짜리 시나리오이므로 5분 워밍업 뒤 다섯 번 기록합니다.The loop ends when is_finished() turns True; with a 10-minute scenario that is five records after the 5-minute warm-up.
